admin.intro: Your organization shares one weekly AI energy pool. Cap it per department or member, top up reserves, and track top-up payments.
admin.permissionBody: You don't have permission to manage your organization's AI energy.
admin.blockedPool: Your organization's shared AI energy is used up for this week.
admin.warningPool: Your organization's shared AI energy is running low this week.

allocations.title: Department & member allocations
allocations.intro: Give a department or member their own weekly cap, or leave them on the shared pool. Reserve energy is spent after the weekly cap.
allocations.emptyBody: Add departments and members to your team to allocate AI energy.

grant.title: Grant energy reserve
grant.body: Add goodwill reserve energy to {name}. This is a manual grant, not a purchase.
grant.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Ran out mid-campaign; covering the shortfall.

topups.title: Top-up payments
topups.intro: Bank-transfer top-ups requested for your organization. Energy is credited once payment is confirmed.
topups.financeNote: Payment confirmation is handled by VinUni finance. You can request and track top-ups here.
topups.emptyBody: Requested energy top-ups will appear here.
topups.confirmDisabled: Only VinUni finance can confirm a payment.
topups.confirmBody: Confirm you received the transfer for {units} energy ({price}). This credits the energy immediately.

toast.allocationCleared: Weekly cap removed — back on the shared pool.

member.title: Buy more energy
member.subtitle: Top up your AI energy with a bank transfer. Energy is added once payment is confirmed.
member.manualHint: Payment is by manual bank transfer and stays pending until confirmed.
member.orgManagedBody: Your team's AI energy is a shared pool managed by an admin. Ask an admin to top up or set you a personal cap.
member.pendingBody: Your top-up of {units} energy ({price}) is pending. Transfer the amount using the details below.

bank.title: Bank transfer instructions
bank.intro: Transfer the exact amount and include the reference so we can match your payment.
bank.doneHint: Once confirmed, your energy is credited automatically. This can take a little time.
